description: Pages when a camera's ~1h-rolling prebuffer restart rate exceeds its threshold and STAYS over it for 20 min of sensor updates (sensor.camera_flap_rate parses the Scrypted log - the churn the snapshot watchdog can't see, because snapshots self-heal between restarts). With a ~1h rolling window, effective time-to-page after onset is ~45-70 min - deliberate for an advisory. Thresholds are per-camera in cam_flap.py: ALERT_HR default plus ALERT_HR_OVERRIDES for a known-chronic camera, so one accepted baseline doesn't desensitize the fleet.

data.title: 📹 Camera stream churn
